title: afflictions
description: Afflictions implements supernatural afflictions, such as: Vampirism and Curses.
body:
# Afflictions

A supernatural afflictions plugin for Paper servers. Turn players into vampires or werewolves, raise werewolf clans, forge alliances and rivalries, curse players with custom debuffs, and more.

## Currently in Beta

The plugin is in active beta. It is feature-rich but still moving fast, so it is best suited to people who do not mind being on the bleeding edge with the occasional bug. Planned for upcoming Release Candidates: MySQL/MariaDB storage (currently falls back to SQLite), an active abilities / skills system, and vampire siring. More PlaceholderAPI placeholders and built-in curses are also on the way.

Found a bug or want to request a feature? Join the [Discord](https://discord.dnoct.me/).

## Features

- **Vampirism** - Sunlight damage, night bonuses, a blood system with feeding, and automatic time-based leveling (Fledgling, Nightstalker, Bloodborn, Elder, Ancient)
- **Werewolves & Clans** - The Lycanthropy affliction with admin-defined, Alpha-run clans, per-role skins via SkinsRestorer, and a `/werewolf transform` toggle
- **Alliances & Relations** - Vampires and werewolf clans form mutual alliances (allies and clanmates can't damage each other) or declare rivalries and enemies, plus Beta-vs-Alpha leadership challenge duels
- **In-game Menu** - `/aff` opens a GUI with a detailed panel per affliction: vampire stats, your clan and pack roster, and a relations card
- **Curses** - Configurable debuff afflictions (weakness, blindness, decay, or create your own)
- **Moon Phases** - 8-phase lunar cycle affecting gameplay
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Full integration for scoreboards, TAB, and chat plugins
- **Persistent Storage** - SQLite with offline player support
- **Fully Configurable** - MiniMessage formatting, per-affliction YAML configs, quiet-by-default console

## Requirements

- Paper 26.1.2 (the plan is to support the latest versions of Minecraft; as Minecraft moves toward newer Java versions, the plugin will always target the latest possible Java for the best performance)
- Java 25+

## Optional

- [SkinsRestorer](https://modrinth.com/plugin/skinsrestorer) - required for werewolf transform skins
- [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi)

## Quick Start

1. Drop the JAR in your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart the server
3. Use `/aff give <player> vampirism` (or `lycanthropy`) to test

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/aff give <player> <affliction> [level]` | Give an affliction |
| `/aff remove <player> <affliction>` | Remove an affliction |
| `/aff clear <player>` | Clear all afflictions |
| `/aff list [player]` | List afflictions |
| `/aff reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/werewolf transform` | Toggle your werewolf skin |
| `/werewolf clan ...` | Run your clan: invite, kick, promote, ally, rival, challenge |
| `/vampire ...` | Manage your own alliances and rivalries |
